name: Beckley Area Foundation Nancy R. Smith Family Fund (Environmental and Wildlife Preservation)
summary: Small field-of-interest grants from a West Virginia community foundation for environmental and wildlife preservation work in Raleigh County, open to 501(c)(3) nonprofits and public bodies.

Programme furthers environmental and wildlife preservation or education in Raleigh County
Complete the project or programme by 2027-02-28
